character: white farm duck, angry payer at the lens; never less than two thirds of the frame height in every window
cast: fat gander manager in a tight waistcoat, owns the terminal, feeds off the tape, from 2.1
motion_rule: no window ends in a pose: its last frame starts the next move; long windows carry two moves in opposite directions
camera_moves: one take; each window's camera move happens there; never held still, never the same size twice
props: terminal post beeps and prints receipt tape by itself; the tape never stops, looping over the ground; card-chip cords on her legs, one more at every beep; her egg bank drops a coin at each beep
environment: village pond at noon, direct sun, hard shadows; the background never stands still, never over a third of frame

audio.delivery: female duck voice, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: плачу at 1.4 is pla-CHU, paying money; плачу at 3.9 is PLA-chu, weeping, never pla-CHU
audio.pacing: one phrase 0.5 to 6.7, no breath at any join; after 6.7 no word at all

timeline.a: a beep, the cord on her leg snaps taut and hauls her half a body back, wings flung up
timeline.c: mid, kicked back with the jerk

timeline.a: 0.5-0.9 she leans her body forward, neck at the lens; 0.9-1.4 the cord throws her back to the post
timeline.c: waist, arcs right round the post

timeline.a: she sweeps a wing under the tape and whips it into a loop across the frame, a coin rolling off
timeline.c: close on the tape, down to the coin

timeline.a: 2.1-2.6 the gander drops a second cord on her leg, she squats under it; 2.6-3.2 she wheels left round the post and tangles, three cords now
timeline.c: full height, walks left round the post

timeline.a: she slams a wing on the terminal, it beeps and shoots fresh tape that whips across her chest
timeline.c: low mid, rises up the post

timeline.a: a fat tear swells and drops off her beak onto the tape, her beak falling after it
timeline.c: macro on the beak, in to the tear

timeline.a: her head snaps round to the gander, a wing thrown out at him across the frame
he catches a coin from her egg bank in his beak, the bank tips at her feet
timeline.c: waist on him, drops after the bank

timeline.a: 5.8-6.2 he treads the terminal button, the tape bursts out and knocks her off her feet; 6.2-6.7 she falls sideways, its loops winding onto her, hens bolting
she hooks the tape with a foot and yanks it sideways round the gander's legs
timeline.c: low on the legs, slides sideways

timeline.a: 7.3-7.6 she rolls over her back, winding him into the tape; 7.6-8.0 she stands and hauls the tape in, he topples forward
8.0-8.4 she rips the chip end of her cord off her leg upward; 8.4-8.8 she slaps it onto his leg, the cords sliding off her onto him
timeline.c: close on the chip, pushes down

timeline.a: she treads the button, coins burst out of him and shower the frame, jolting him
she sits on the empty egg bank, pins the last coin under a wing, head turning to the lens
timeline.c: mid front, eases in on her face

must_appear: the tape fills the frame at 1.4; the tear on her beak at 3.9; a cord on her leg in every window she is in, to 8.4
negative_prompt: cyrillic, subtitles, dark scene, slow motion, any Russian word outside the lines, speech after 6.7, the gander speaking, extra limbs, a copy of the duck, a locked camera, the duck small in frame, a pose held to the end of a window, a move played out early, both плачу said with the same stress
